propositions: Version numbers must be bumped in lockstep across pyproject.toml and server.json (top-level and packages[] entries) and validated by release_guards.py before release.
CHANGELOG.md must be updated with a curated release section for the new version and compare-links before pushing the release commit.
Local gates (lint, typecheck, test) and artifact metadata validation (twine check) must pass on the release worktree before committing and pushing.
The release commit must land on main through Gerrit with both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 votes before dispatch to PyPI.
The released version must be published to PyPI and a GitHub Release created at the merged main SHA, with verification commands confirming availability and correctness.
